name: Ragefire Chasm
strategy: Oggleflint: mark and kill his two adds first
Taragaman the Hungerer: watch positioning: his Uppercut can knock people into the lava
Jergosh the Invoker: clear his two adds, interrupt Immolate, watch mana
Bazzalan: hits hard; cleanse Deadly Poison and kill his two adds first
tips: Packs are tight: pull carefully, use line of sight and crowd control
Only Horde can do its 5 quests; Alliance get the Hall of Thanes instead

name: The Deadmines
location: Defias Hideout, south-west Moonbrook, Westfall (42, 72); follow the cave down
strategy: Rhahk'zor: kill the Watchmen first
Miner Johnson (rare): tank and spank
Sneed's Shredder: clear the Woodcarvers; after the Shredder dies, taunt Sneed (he disarms: use non-weapon abilities)
Gilnid: clear his room first: Molten Metal lowers tank threat
Mr. Smite: kill the Blackguards; save cooldowns for phase two when he dual-wields
Captain Greenskin: kill his two adds first; easy to pull by accident
Edwin VanCleef: kill the first adds, control the second set, burn him below half health
Cookie: interrupt Cookie's Cooking (heals him)
tips: Unchanged from Classic apart from loot; one new quest in a new Westfall chain

name: Wailing Caverns
location: Cavern of Mists, Lushwater Oasis, The Barrens (46.0, 36.3); portal in the big pool cavern
strategy: Kresh: tank facing away, cooldowns for big hits; casters do best (high armour)
Lady Anacondra: interrupt Lightning Bolt, Sleep and Healing Touch
Lord Cobran: kill his three Deviate Pythons first; HoT the tank in case healers get slept
Deviate Faerie Dragon: burn without pulling aggro
Lord Pythas: hold the Druid of the Fang add too; interrupt casts
Skum: face him away, spread for Chained Bolt and interrupt it (Nature immune)
Lord Serpentis: interrupt Healing Touch, Sleep and Lightning Bolt
Verdan the Everliving: healers stand far back; ranged 10+ yards from Grasping Vines
Mutanus the Devourer: kill oozes and snakes first, tank him away from Naralex's disciple, interrupt Naralex's Nightmare
tips: New loot includes a set that turns Druid Cat Form into a serpent
Elites patrol the outer cavern: travel as a group

name: Shadowfang Keep
location: Silverpine Forest, in the hills north of Pyrewood Village (44.5, 68.0)
strategy: Rethilgore: kill his adds first; healers cover Wavering Will (must die to open the courtyard)
Razorclaw the Butcher: clear and mark the adds first
Baron Silverlaine: clear his room; interrupt or decurse Veil of Shadow (-75% healing)
Commander Springvale: pull small groups; interrupt Holy Light after his Divine Shield at 30%
Odo the Blindwatcher: kill the Vile Bats; save cooldowns for under 50% (Howling Rage)
Deathsworn Captain: face him away (Cleave), DPS behind
Fenrus the Devourer: tank and spank with defensives
Wolf Master Nandos: wolves join at 80%: cleave them carefully
Archmage Arugal: crowd-control mind-controlled players; his curse can't be dispelled
tips: Skyborne can reach it easily from Dalaran

name: The Stockade
location: Stormwind canals near the Mage Quarter (42, 58)
strategy: Targorr the Dread: kill adds first
Kam Deepfury: hold aggro through Shield Slam stuns; kill adds first
Hamhock: kill his two Defias adds; interrupt Chain Lightning, purge Bloodlust
Bazil Thredd: clear the room before pulling
Bruegal Ironknuckle (rare): tank and spank
Dextren Ward: kill adds first; be ready for Intimidating Shout
tips: The T-shaped cell block wings can be done in any order

name: Blackfathom Deeps
location: Zoram Strand, north-west Ashenvale (14.5, 14.6): swim through the pool and follow the naga cave
strategy: Ghamoo-ra: face it away; reposition after Trample
Lady Sarevess: crowd-control one add; spread out for Forked Lightning
Gelihast: pull his room's adds one at a time; ranged stay close so Net lowers threat; click the stone behind him for Blessing of Blackfathom
Lorgus Jett: tank and spank; watch melee for Lightning Shield
Baron Aquanis: tank and spank
Twilight Lord Kelris: tank away from the group; taunt if the tank is slept
Old Serra'kis: underwater: manage breath
Aku'mai: tank away from ranged, step out of Poison Cloud, save stuns and cooldowns for Frenzied Rage
tips: Lorgus Jett and Baron Aquanis are for Horde quests
